name: Martorell (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and blue, with a yellow tower in the upper hoist canton.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council on 23 March 1995 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya; it is an oblong flag of 2:3 divided into three equal vertical stripes of green, white and blue, with the yellow tower one third of the height in the canton, separated from the upper edge by 1/9.

features.role: tower in the canton, one third of the height
